Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
I have some questions regarding Advanced Dominique's ability to burn
locations I control to gain X pool where X is the cost of the location.

- How does ability work with locations that cost blood instead of pool,
e.g. Local 1111? Can I burn a Local 1111 to gain 2 pool? If I can't
gain pool (since I paid for the Local 1111 in blood), can I at least
burn it with Dominique's ability and gain nothing (e.g. to stop
someone stealing it in a future turn)?
- What happens if I use some effect to reduce the cost of a location
(e.g. Powerbase: Tshwane when playing a hunting ground) when I bring it
into play; if I later burn it with Dominique's ability do I gain the
full cost printed on the card (2), or the modified cost (1) that I paid
for it?

thanks

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Dasein wrote:
> I have some questions regarding Advanced Dominique's ability to burn
> locations I control to gain X pool where X is the cost of the location.
>
> - How does ability work with locations that cost blood instead of pool,

Just fine, since the text only refers to "cost", not restricted to "pool cost".

> e.g. Local 1111? Can I burn a Local 1111 to gain 2 pool? If I can't

Yes.

> gain pool (since I paid for the Local 1111 in blood), can I at least
> burn it with Dominique's ability and gain nothing (e.g. to stop
> someone stealing it in a future turn)?

Moot.

> - What happens if I use some effect to reduce the cost of a location
> (e.g. Powerbase: Tshwane when playing a hunting ground) when I bring it
> into play; if I later burn it with Dominique's ability do I gain the
> full cost printed on the card (2), or the modified cost (1) that I paid
> for it?

Full cost.
